title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Jerry vocals and a beloved Pigpen era show make this recording enjoyable despite mixed listener opinions.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the pristine vocal clarity—especially Jerry’s voice—and the nostalgic value of the Pigpen‑filled set, calling it an excellent capture of the old‑school Dead. One reviewer felt it was merely “OK for a bunch of kids,” giving the overall sentiment a mixed tone but still leaning positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Three 5‑star reviews praise both performance and sound quality, while one 2‑star review is negative; the average rating (4.25) reflects a strong show with good recording, yielding a solid 4.3 overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crystal‑clear vocal clarity, especially Jerry’s voice; no specific complaints about distortion or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers simply reference the era and Pigpen presence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as crystal clear, still shining decades later.
